name: (BERSERK) Confrontation with Griffith
description: You stand in a dark forest, its silence broken only by rustling leaves and heavy breathing. Reborn Griffith appears before you—a beautiful yet terrifying white-winged being whose icy gaze cuts straight through you. This is a fateful encounter with his dark power. His aura of terror weighs upon you, but you are ready to fight with strength and will. Prepare to face a demonic leader more powerful than anything in this ruined world.
